notes.title: Fully revised demo released
notes.notes: [p]Thanks to everyone who has tried the game so far. I have been adding a heap of new features and quality of life upgrades and have finally got these into a build. I will aim to update more frequently in the run up to the full game being released in December.[/p][p][/p][h1]List of Major Changes[/h1][p][/p][h3]New village map + fast travel system[/h3][h3]New areas to explore, including the forest and canal [/h3][h3]Brand new soundtrack, featuring songs by Katy Kirby[/h3][h3]15 achievements (will be connected to Steam in the full game) [/h3][h3]New time of day system means detecting in the day, evening & night[/h3][h3]Several new characters and missions[/h3][h3]Controls fully refined and revised for gamepad[/h3][h3]New persistent instruction menu [/h3][h3]Revised tutorial [/h3][h3]Optional real-time detector help[/h3][h3]A new ending to the demo that I hope you find devastating (...)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/c7627f422f5e998b66eb3c477f8189a5611f3000.png"][/img][/p][h2]Minor changes/details[/h2][p][/p][p]–         Game controller layout changed: “X” now used for pin-pointer and digging ✓      [/p][p]–         More signposts on streets ✓[/p][p]–         Extra UI sounds added ✓[/p][p]–         Keyboard (M) and gamepad (left menu button) shortcuts to open/close map ✓[/p][p]–         Time of day system linked to in-game progress ✓[/p][p]–         Persistent instructions gives info on ground balance and frequencies to help you search ✓[/p][p]–         Refined all text speech, making everything easier to read ✓[/p][p]–         Clear signs for hardware, pet and antique shop + Police station and museum ✓[/p][p]–         All speech made a lot more northern! ✓[/p][p]–         All ambient sounds refined and remixed ✓[/p][p]–         Fully revised missions with clearer updates throughout ✓  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/ad0aefdb1d938280fefb02d61abd86dd50e74b81.png"][/img][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/d53f7662624cf1a75d8a9d7c705e48a4b06edf64.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Run n' Map update
notes.notes: [p]Thanks to our play-testers who noted three things: 1) we'd like to move faster; 2) we don't know where we're going; 3) where are the achievements?! Some excellent points. The game now has a little run button, boosting movement speed by x2 and I honestly don't know how I managed without it. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/889a4a4526c2675e02e4d1a0e4dd8634035d81b4.png"][/img][/p][p]There is also a village map and I took the opportunity to revamp the menu items more generally. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/bbcba737f2b2028952d9ec69bcfae0197f07c876.png"][/img][/p][p]I have also started on an achievements system. They've been designed and the UI is done. Now, I need to hook them up so they actually activate then figure out the Steam side of things...[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/d53f7662624cf1a75d8a9d7c705e48a4b06edf64.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: News: Developer learns community page actually exists!
notes.notes: [h1]News: Developer learns community page actually exists![/h1][p]Thank you so much to those of you who joined this community and my sincere apologies and great admission of stupidity in that I literally learned today that this community feature existed! Needless to say, now I know this is here, I will be posting regular updates including a pile of stuff I updated on the game and never shared! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271614/3b5c2ded04a4cd04473f6e98506eaeb936fdd423.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for taking interest in The Detectorist Guild![/p]
